subject: general
question: Which king of Punjab signed a tripartite treaty with Shah Shujah and the English Company?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ranjit Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Tripartite Treaty was signed in 1838 by Maharaja Ranjit Singh, Shah Shujah of Afghanistan, and the British East India Company.
 
• This treaty was aimed at placing Shah Shujah on the throne of Kabul with the help of Maharaja Ranjit Singh and the British.
 
• In exchange for his assistance, Ranjit Singh was recognized by the British and Shah Shujah as the legitimate ruler of the territories he had annexed.
 
• The treaty was a significant event in the lead-up to the First Anglo-Afghan War (1839-1842).
 
• It highlighted the British strategy of establishing a buffer state in Afghanistan between India and Russia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
Fact

 
 
 
Detail

 
 
 

 
 
Ranjit Singh

 
 
 
Founder of the Sikh Empire, which lasted from 1799 to 1849.

 
 
 

 
 
First Anglo-Afghan War

 
 
 
A conflict between British India and Afghanistan, resulting from the British attempt to establish a puppet state.

 
 
 

 
 
Sikh Empire

 
 
 
Known for its military prowess, administrative reforms, and for being a multireligious, multicultural empire.

 
 
 

 
 
British East India Company

 
 
 
A British company which played a major role in the expansion of the British Empire in India through trade and conquest.
